root_cause_assessment: Established: code/12_analyze_rule_structure.py calculated Table 11 from experiments_meta.csv, and the archived output reproduces exactly from that CSV (0/1,984 A12 and 0/1,984 paired-p mismatches). The surviving experiments_meta.parquet matches the consolidated PSO_FCS scores exactly outside corrected F14; recomputing archived-style tests from Parquet yields 37 non-F14 A12 and 52 non-F14 paired-p mismatches. This isolates CSV float serialization/round-trip precision as the root cause of the non-F14 discrepancies, where tiny score differences can change pairwise ties/ranks and Wilcoxon differences. F14 correction separately changes F14 comparisons. The new independent Mann–Whitney p-values/A12 are independently verified against the consolidated full-precision samples.
